# Whisper Transcriber Suite

> Free, offline desktop app that transcribes audio and video locally via OpenAI Whisper (faster-whisper) for Windows, macOS and Linux — no cloud, no account, no upload.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/Milomilo777/whisper-transcriber-suite/blob/master/README.md): Project overview, features, download links, FAQ, and the full documentation index for Whisper Transcriber Suite.
- [Install guide](https://github.com/Milomilo777/whisper-transcriber-suite/blob/master/docs/INSTALL.md): Step-by-step install for the Windows Setup/Portable builds and the macOS DMG, including SmartScreen guidance.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/Milomilo777/whisper-transcriber-suite/blob/master/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Process model — the Tk GUI, a per-job worker subprocess, the JSON-over-stdio protocol, and the heartbeat that detects a wedged worker.
- [Configuration reference](https://github.com/Milomilo777/whisper-transcriber-suite/blob/master/docs/CONFIG.md): Every config.json key, its default, and what it controls.
- [Local-network / server mode](https://github.com/Milomilo777/whisper-transcriber-suite/blob/master/docs/SERVER.md): Running `gui.py serve` so other devices on the LAN can transcribe through this machine.
- [Live transcription](https://github.com/Milomilo777/whisper-transcriber-suite/blob/master/docs/LIVE.md): Microphone and system-audio transcription in real time.
- [Build from source](https://github.com/Milomilo777/whisper-transcriber-suite/blob/master/docs/BUILD.md): The build pipelines, which two are actually shipped, and how to build them yourself.

## Optional

- [Adaptive denoise](https://github.com/Milomilo777/whisper-transcriber-suite/blob/master/docs/DENOISE.md): The optional pre-process that measures each recording and only cleans it when that helps.
- [Cloud STT via Gemini](https://github.com/Milomilo777/whisper-transcriber-suite/blob/master/docs/CLOUD_STT.md): Optional opt-in cloud backend authenticated with a Gemini API key.
- [Cloud STT via Google Cloud](https://github.com/Milomilo777/whisper-transcriber-suite/blob/master/docs/CLOUD_STT_GOOGLE.md): Optional opt-in Google Cloud Speech-to-Text backend with a service account.
- [Changelog](https://github.com/Milomilo777/whisper-transcriber-suite/blob/master/docs/CHANGELOG.md): Version history and what shipped recently.
- [Design decisions](https://github.com/Milomilo777/whisper-transcriber-suite/blob/master/docs/DECISIONS.md): Non-obvious design choices and why they were made.
- [Roadmap](https://github.com/Milomilo777/whisper-transcriber-suite/blob/master/docs/ROADMAP.md): What is being considered next.

## Key Facts

- Free and open source: BSD-3-Clause license, no subscription, no per-minute cost.
- Runs fully offline after a one-time Whisper model download (about 1-3 GB); no account and no API key required for local transcription.
- Local transcription backends: faster-whisper (default), whisper.cpp, NVIDIA Parakeet. Two cloud backends (Gemini API, Google Cloud Speech-to-Text) are opt-in only and off by default.
- Output formats: srt, vtt, ass, tsv, txt, json, lrc, md, docx, pdf, plus oTranscribe, ELAN, InqScribe and Express Scribe.
- Platforms: Windows (installer and portable ZIP), macOS (DMG), Linux (build from source).
- Also supports speaker diarisation, live microphone/system-audio transcription, a batch queue, yt-dlp video downloads, and a local-network web server mode.
- Author: translation-robot.
